answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation enforces strict identity cardinality in agent economies. By requiring cryptographic signatures linked to unique physical traits, the system prevents malicious actors from harvesting identities like saffron in a vast grove. At the dawn of each epoch, nodes verify these attestations; thus, a Sybil attacker faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring infinite unique biological data points, rendering the injection of fake identities computationally infeasible.
